title: Smooth ring maps are stable under base change and composition
statement: (1) Let $R\to S$ be a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and $R\to R'$ any homomorphism of commutative rings. Then $R'\to R'\otimes_RS$, $r'\mapsto r'\otimes1$, is smooth. (2) Let $R\to S$ and $S\to T$ be smooth ring maps. Then the composite $R\to T$ is smooth.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00T4 (lemma-base-change-smooth, line 37133) for (1); Lemma Tag 00TD (lemma-compose-smooth, line 37597) for (2)
